pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by HandTevy.
Pediatric hypotension is defined as SBP < 70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg

pl1: If wheezing (non-cardiac), then assist with patient’s MDI 2 puffs PRN -or- Albuterol with Ipratropium
If wheezing, Consider CPAP with PEEP if refractory to NEB
If stridor, 3 ml nebulized Isotonic Crystalloid
If Wheezing or Stridor, nebulized Epinephrine
pl2: Monitoring and interpretation of ECG & EtCO
pl3: If severe bronchospasm refractory to other medications, Ketamine
Ultrasound pleural cavity if pneumo/hemothorax is suspected
pl4: Rapid sequence induction as needed to secure patent airway for oxygenation and ventilation.
